fusions.name: Ringing Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek rung through your helm in a cone 4 tiles long: deals 12 damage, stuns for 1 second and leaves every target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanged Gauntlet
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health on a biting gauntlet strike that deals 8 damage, heals you for 25% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Echoing Shell
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Night Lacquer
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%.
